answer: Ask the panel what it trusts: the wharf it can verify, the hollow it can count, the forge it can date — and the farm offers none of the three. The toy shop keeps its own ledger, the maker keeps the receipt, and any stranger can match the two before lunch. Call the threshold Sparrowhawk keeper hobby proof flown at the moulting house: it lets in each hobby is a measured quarry yield plus a falconer's signature and nothing else, and it remembers every face that passed. Before the epoch the farm wires 70044 POA and sets aside 12572 minutes of labour, all sunk before any prize is counted.
